integrity.proof_type: analytic with exact symbolic consistency checks

scientific_limitations: Scalar deterministic infinite-horizon continuous-time LQR with state and control weights one, x(0)=1 and exact Euclidean policy gradient only.
Only hyperbolic local attraction/repulsion is classified; the neutral \(t=1\) and \(t=t_*\) cases, higher-period orbits and global basins are not resolved.
No claims about noisy model-free updates, matrix systems, finite precision or runtime advantage.
Novelty checked against specified primary sources and published records, but unindexed equivalent prior work may exist.
title: Sharp invariant-gain and flip-cycle thresholds for scalar continuous-time LQR gradient descent
